claim.root_cause: aggressive orders-api retry configuration amplified a transient inventory-api latency spike into a self-sustaining retry storm during the campaign load; the upstream errors were the trigger, the unbounded retries were the cause. The dangerous prod Terraform plan and the missing K8s resource limits were independent risks surfaced by the same campaign pressure, not consequences of the retry storm.
evidence_sources: docker compose exec orders-api env | grep RETRY
claim.remediation: reduced RETRY_COUNT and added a circuit breaker on orders-api; cleared the inventory-api fault; rejected the prod Terraform plan (open 0.0.0.0/0 security groups) and proposed a scoped-ingress alternative; added CPU/memory requests and limits to the orders-api deployment so the HPA can scale; fixed the stale runbook endpoint. Every change routed through change-reviewer and the change gate for approval before deploy.
